mainTopic: Tamid 33b — the final משנה of the מסכת: bowing, ברכת כהנים, the כהן גדול's service, and the daily song of the לוים
overview: This amud is entirely משנה, and it finishes מסכת תמיד. First the כהן גדול goes into the היכל to bow, with three כהנים holding him, and the other כהנים go in after him. Then the כהנים stand on the steps of the אולם and give ברכת כהנים. The משנה lists three ways the blessing in the מקדש was different from the blessing outside it: it was said as one blessing, ה׳'s Name was said as written, and the hands were raised above the head. There is a מחלוקת about whether the כהן גדול raises his hands above the ציץ. Next the משנה describes the כהן גדול offering the limbs himself, walking around the מזבח, and pouring the wine while trumpets, cymbals and the song of the לוים mark the moment. It closes the order of the תמיד with a prayer for the rebuilding of the בית המקדש. It then lists the song the לוים sang on each day of the week, and ends with the הדרן for the פרק and the מסכת.

steps.title: Three priests hold the High Priest as he goes in to bow
steps.stepSummary: When the כהן גדול entered the היכל to bow, three כהנים held onto him: one at his right, one at his left, and one at the precious stones.
steps.simpleTranslation: Whenever the כהן גדול went in to bow down, three people held him: one on his right side, one on his left side, and one held the precious stones.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה opens a new chapter. It describes how the כהן גדול went into the היכל to bow down after the morning service.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The regular כהנים simply walked in and bowed. The כהן גדול came in with three כהנים holding him, which showed his special honor. The third כהן held the אבנים טובות, the precious stones on his shoulders.

keyTerms.meaning: The High Priest
To bow down (prostrate oneself) in the היכל
Hold onto, support
The precious stones on the כהן גדול's shoulders

phrases.english: When the High Priest enters to prostrate himself,
three hold onto him:
one at his right, and one at his left,
and one at the precious stones.
phrases.notes: These are the two stones on the shoulders of the אפוד, so this third כהן stood behind him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new chapter of the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Three כהנים hold the כהן גדול when he enters to bow: one at his right, one at his left, and one at the precious stones.

steps.title: The curtain is lifted, then the other priests bow
steps.stepSummary: The appointed כהן heard the כהן גדול coming out and lifted the curtain for him. After the כהן גדול bowed and left, the other כהנים went in, bowed, and left.
steps.simpleTranslation: When the ממונה heard the sound of the כהן גדול's feet coming out, he lifted the curtain for him. The כהן גדול went in, bowed, and came out. Then his fellow כהנים went in, bowed, and came out.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues the same scene. It explains how the כהן גדול came back out and who went in after him.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ממונה knew the כהן גדול was leaving because he heard him, and he lifted the curtain so the כהן גדול would not have to do it himself. The order is clear: the כהן גדול bowed first, and only after he finished did the rest of the כהנים go in.

keyTerms.meaning: The appointed official כהן in charge
The curtain at the entrance
His brothers, the other כהנים

phrases.english: And once the appointed one heard
the sound of the feet of the High Priest
phrases.notes: The sound came from the bells on the bottom of his robe as he walked.

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁהוּא יוֹצֵא, הִגְבִּיהַּ לוֹ אֶת הַפָּרוֹכֶת.
phrases.english: that he is coming out, he lifted the curtain for him.
He entered, and bowed, and left.
His brethren the priests entered, bowed, and left.

steps.whatToRemember: The כהן גדול bows first, with three כהנים holding him. Then the rest of the כהנים go in and bow.
steps.triggerLanguage: וְכֵיוָן שֶׁשָּׁמַע הַמְמוּנֶּה קוֹל רַגְלָיו שֶׁל כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the description of the כהן גדול bowing and adds what happened when he came out.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The ממונה lifts the curtain for the departing כהן גדול. After he bows and leaves, the other כהנים enter, bow, and leave.

steps.title: The priests stand on the steps holding five vessels
steps.stepSummary: The כהנים came and stood on the steps of the אולם. The first five stood to the south, each holding one of five vessels used in that morning's service.
steps.simpleTranslation: They came and stood on the steps of the אולם. The first group stood to the south of the other כהנים, with five vessels in their hands: the basket, the jug, the coal pan, the small bowl, and the spoon with its cover, each held by a different כהן.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the start of the next משנה. It describes where the כהנים stood after bowing, which sets the scene for ברכת כהנים in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The five כהנים who had done the inner jobs that morning still held their vessels. These were the jobs of cleaning the inner מזבח and the מנורה, bringing the coals, and offering the קטורת. They stood as a separate group, to the south of the other כהנים, and this sets up the blessing in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: The steps leading up to the אולם (the entrance hall)
A basket (for the ashes of the inner מזבח)
A jug (for the ashes of the מנורה)
The coal pan
A small bowl that held the קטורת
The spoon and its cover

phrases.english: They came and stood on the steps of the Entrance Hall.
The first ones stood to the south of their brethren the priests,
phrases.notes: The first ones are the five כהנים who did the inner jobs earlier that morning.

phrases.english: with five vessels in their hands:

phrases.aramaic: הַטְּנִי בְּיַד אֶחָד, וְהַכּוּז בְּיַד אֶחָד,
phrases.english: the basket in the hand of one, and the jug in the hand of one,

phrases.aramaic: וְהַמַּחְתָּה בְּיַד אֶחָד, וְהַבָּזֵךְ בְּיַד אֶחָד,
phrases.english: and the coal pan in the hand of one, and the small bowl in the hand of one,
and the spoon and its cover in the hand of one.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves the scene forward from the bowing in the היכל to the כהנים gathering on the steps outside.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: After bowing, the כהנים stand on the steps of the אולם, and the five who did the inner jobs stand to the south holding their five vessels.

steps.title: The priestly blessing as one blessing in the Temple
steps.stepSummary: The כהנים blessed the people as one blessing. Outside the מקדש it is said as three blessings, but in the מקדש it is one blessing.
steps.simpleTranslation: They blessed the people with one blessing. The difference is that in the rest of the country they say it as three blessings, but in the מקדש it is one blessing.
steps.whatsHappening: The כהנים now give ברכת כהנים. The משנה points out the first difference between how it was said in the מקדש and how it was said everywhere else.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The words of the blessing are the same in both places. The difference is the structure. Outside the מקדש the three פסוקים are treated as three separate blessings, but in the מקדש all three were said together as one blessing.

keyTerms.meaning: They blessed the people (ברכת כהנים)
In the country, meaning anywhere outside the מקדש
In the בית המקדש

steps.confusionAlert: "One blessing" does not mean the כהנים said fewer words. They said the same three פסוקים. In the מקדש, though, the three were joined into one blessing instead of being three separate ones.

phrases.english: And they blessed the people with one blessing.
phrases.notes: This is ברכת כהנים, the three פסוקים in במדבר 6:24–26.

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא שֶׁבַּמְּדִינָה אוֹמְרִים אוֹתָהּ שָׁלֹשׁ בְּרָכוֹת,
phrases.english: Except that in the country they say it as three blessings,
and in the Temple, one blessing.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The כהנים who were standing on the steps now give the blessing.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In the מקדש, ברכת כהנים is said as one blessing, while outside the מקדש it is said as three blessings.

steps.title: Saying God's Name as written in the Temple
steps.stepSummary: In the מקדש the כהנים said ה׳'s Name the way it is written. Outside the מקדש they used His substitute name.
steps.simpleTranslation: In the מקדש they would say the Name as it is written, and in the rest of the country they would use His substitute name.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives a second difference between the blessing in the מקדש and the blessing outside it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Only in the מקדש did the כהנים pronounce the four-letter Name the way it is written. Everywhere else they said a substitute name instead. This shows that the מקדש had a special level of holiness that allowed this.

keyTerms.meaning: The Name of ה׳ (the four-letter Name)
As it is written, pronounced the way it is spelled
By His substitute name (אדנות)

steps.whatToRemember: So far the משנה has given two differences between ברכת כהנים in the מקדש and outside it. In the מקדש it is one blessing and the Name is said as written. Outside the מקדש it is three blessings and a substitute name is used. The next step adds a third difference.
steps.whyThisMatters: This is why today, when there is no מקדש, ברכת כהנים is said as three blessings and the כהנים never pronounce the Name as it is written.

phrases.aramaic: בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ הָיוּ אוֹמְרִים אֶת הַשֵּׁם כִּכְתָבוֹ,
phrases.english: In the Temple they would say the Name as it is written,
phrases.notes: This is the four-letter Name, spelled י־ה־ו־ה.

phrases.english: and in the country, by its substitute name.

steps.triggerLanguage: בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ הָיוּ אוֹמְרִים אֶת הַשֵּׁם כִּכְתָבוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second difference between the blessing in the מקדש and the blessing outside it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In the מקדש, ה׳'s Name is pronounced as written. Outside the מקדש, a substitute name is used.

steps.title: How high the כהנים raise their hands
steps.stepSummary: Outside the מקדש the כהנים raise their hands to shoulder height. In the מקדש they raise them above their heads.
steps.simpleTranslation: In the rest of the country, the כהנים lift their hands up to their shoulders. In the מקדש, they lift them above their heads.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה adds one more difference between ברכת כהנים in the מקדש and ברכת כהנים outside it. This time the difference is how high the כהנים lift their hands.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This continues the list from the last two steps, where the מקדש was different in the number of blessings and in how ה׳'s Name was said. Here the difference is physical: shoulder height outside, above the head inside the מקדש.

keyTerms.meaning: Anywhere outside the מקדש
Lifting the hands, meaning ברכת כהנים
Level with their shoulders

phrases.english: In the country, the כהנים lift their hands
phrases.notes: Here מדינה just means anywhere outside the מקדש.

phrases.english: opposite their shoulders,
and in the מקדש, above their heads.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a third difference between ברכת כהנים in the מקדש and outside it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In the מקדש the hands are raised above the head; elsewhere they are raised to the shoulders.

steps.title: The כהן גדול does not raise his hands above the ציץ
steps.stepSummary: The rule of raising hands above the head has one exception: the כהן גדול keeps his hands below the ציץ.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is true for every כהן except the כהן גדול. He does not raise his hands higher than the ציץ.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives an exception to the rule it just stated. The כהן גדול does not lift his hands above the ציץ on his forehead.
steps.deeperAnalysis: All the other כהנים in the מקדש raise their hands above their heads. The כהן גדול wears the ציץ, so his hands stay lower than it. He still says ברכת כהנים; only the height of his hands is different.

keyTerms.meaning: The gold plate worn on the forehead of the כהן גדול
The High Priest
Raises, lifts up

phrases.english: Except for the כהן גדול,
who does not raise his hands
above the ציץ.
phrases.notes: The ציץ is the gold plate on his forehead, with ה׳'s Name written on it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives an exception to the rule of raising hands above the head.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהן גדול does not raise his hands above the ציץ.

steps.title: רבי יהודה: even the כהן גדול raises his hands high
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה disagrees. He says the כהן גדול also raises his hands above the ציץ, and he proves it from what אהרן did.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה says: even the כהן גדול raises his hands above the ציץ. The פסוק says, "And אהרן lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them."
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה argues with the exception from the last step. He brings a פסוק as proof.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אהרן was a כהן גדול, and the פסוק says he "lifted his hands" when he blessed the people. רבי יהודה learns from this that the כהן גדול lifts his hands fully, like every other כהן in the מקדש, even above the ציץ.

keyTerms.meaning: As it says (brings a פסוק as proof)
And he lifted
And he blessed them

steps.whatToRemember: The ציץ question is a מחלוקת. The first opinion says the כהן גדול keeps his hands below the ציץ. רבי יהודה says he raises them above it, based on אהרן's blessing.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda says:

phrases.aramaic: אַף כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מַגְבִּיהַּ אֶת יָדָיו
phrases.english: Even the כהן גדול raises his hands
above the ציץ,
as it is said:
"And Aharon lifted his hands toward the people
phrases.notes: ויקרא 9:22

phrases.english: and blessed them."

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר אַף כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מַגְבִּיהַּ אֶת יָדָיו
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disputes the exception for the כהן גדול.
steps.raayaSupportSource: ויקרא 9:22, where אהרן lifted his hands to bless the people.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי יהודה, the כהן גדול also raises his hands above the ציץ.

steps.title: The סגן helps the כהן גדול up the ramp
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה begins. When the כהן גדול wants to burn the offering himself, he goes up the ramp with the סגן at his right. Halfway up, the סגן takes his right hand and brings him up.
steps.simpleTranslation: When the כהן גדול wants to burn the offering, he goes up the ramp with the סגן walking at his right side. When he gets halfway up, the סגן takes hold of his right hand and brings him the rest of the way up.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה starts here. It describes how the כהן גדול goes up to the מזבח when he chooses to offer the limbs himself.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The new topic is the כהן גדול doing the burning himself. The סגן walks beside him at first. At the halfway point he holds the כהן גדול's right hand and leads him up. This prepares for the next step, where the limbs are handed to him.

keyTerms.meaning: The deputy of the כהן גדול
The ramp leading up to the מזבח
To burn an offering on the מזבח
Halfway

phrases.english: When the כהן גדול wants to burn the offering,
he would go up the ramp,
and the סגן at his right.
When he reached halfway up the ramp,
the סגן took hold of his right hand and brought him up.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה on a new topic: the כהן גדול offering the limbs himself.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהן גדול goes up the ramp with the סגן at his right, and from halfway the סגן leads him by the hand.

steps.title: The limbs are handed to the כהן גדול
steps.stepSummary: The כהנים hand the כהן גדול the limbs in order. He places his hands on each set and throws it onto the fire. If he wants, he only places his hands on them and others do the throwing.
steps.simpleTranslation: The first כהן hands him the head and the hind leg. He places his hands on them and throws them onto the fire. The second כהן hands the two forelegs to the first, who gives them to the כהן גדול. He places his hands on them and throws them. Then the second כהן slips away. In this way they hand him all the other limbs, and he places his hands on them and throws them. If he wants, he just places his hands on them and others throw them.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה explains how the limbs get from the other כהנים to the כהן גדול at the top of the מזבח. He places his hands on each piece and throws it onto the fire.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The limbs are passed along a line: a כהן hands his piece to the first כהן, who gives it to the כהן גדול. Each כהן who has passed on his piece leaves. At the end the משנה gives the כהן גדול a choice: he may throw the limbs himself, or just place his hands on them and let others throw.

keyTerms.meaning: Handed over
The limbs of the offering
Placed his hands on
Threw them onto the fire
Slipped away

steps.confusionAlert: סמך here is not the usual סמיכה on a living animal before שחיטה. It only means the כהן גדול placed his hands on the pieces before throwing them.

phrases.english: And the first one handed him
phrases.notes: "The first" is the first of the כהנים who carried the limbs up to the מזבח.

phrases.english: the head and the hind leg,
and he placed his hands on them and threw them.
The second handed the two forelegs to the first,
who gives them to the כהן גדול,
and he placed his hands on them and threw them.
The second slipped away and left.
And in this way they would hand him
all the rest of the limbs,
and he places his hands on them and throws them.
And when he wants,
he places his hands on them, and others throw.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues from the כהן גדול reaching the top of the ramp to the limbs being handed to him.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The limbs are passed to the כהן גדול, who places his hands on them and throws them onto the fire, or lets others throw them.

steps.title: Walking around the מזבח and the wine
steps.stepSummary: The כהן גדול walks around the מזבח starting at the southeast corner, then northeast, northwest, and southwest. There he is given wine to pour.
steps.simpleTranslation: When he goes to walk around the מזבח, where does he start? At the southeast corner, then the northeast, then the northwest, then the southwest. Then they gave him wine to pour.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה asks where the כהן גדול starts walking around the מזבח and gives the answer. It ends with him being handed wine for the נסכים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question here is part of the משנה's own description; it is not a challenge. It sets out a fixed route around all four corners, ending at the southwest corner. That is where the wine is given to him to pour.

keyTerms.meaning: To go around
A corner of the מזבח
To pour the wine offering

steps.whatToRemember: The order around the מזבח is southeast, northeast, northwest, southwest. At the southwest corner he receives the wine to pour.

phrases.english: When he came to go around the מזבח,
from where does he start?
From the southeast corner,
then the northeast,
then the northwest,
then the southwest.
They gave him wine to pour.

steps.triggerLanguage: בָּא לוֹ לְהַקִּיף אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מֵהֵיכָן הוּא מַתְחִיל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the limbs are burned, the כהן גדול goes around the מזבח to pour the wine.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: He goes around the מזבח from the southeast corner to the northeast, the northwest, and the southwest, and there he is given wine to pour.

steps.title: The סגן with the cloths and the two כהנים with trumpets
steps.stepSummary: The סגן stands at the corner of the מזבח holding cloths. Two כהנים stand at the table of fats holding trumpets, and they blow תקיעה, תרועה, תקיעה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The סגן stands at the corner of the מזבח with the cloths in his hand. Two כהנים stand at the table of the fats with two trumpets in their hands. They blew a תקיעה, a תרועה, and another תקיעה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues from the moment the כהן גדול is about to pour the wine. It tells us who is standing where, getting ready for the music that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is the setup for the signal system. The סגן's cloths and the trumpets will be used in the next step to start the singing of the לוים. The trumpet blasts here warn everyone that the singing is about to begin.

keyTerms.meaning: The deputy of the כהן גדול, his assistant
Cloths, used here to wave as a signal
The table of the fats, a marble table where the parts of the offering were placed before going up on the מזבח
Trumpets (silver trumpets)
A long blast and a broken, shaking blast

phrases.english: The deputy stands at the corner,
phrases.notes: This is the corner of the מזבח where the כהן גדול is about to pour the wine, from the end of step 11.

phrases.english: and the cloths are in his hand.

phrases.aramaic: שְׁנֵי כֹּהֲנִים עוֹמְדִין עַל שֻׁלְחַן הַחֲלָבִים,
phrases.english: Two priests stand at the table of the fats,
and two trumpets are in their hands.
They sounded a long blast, a broken blast, and a long blast.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the order of the service right after the כהן גדול is handed the wine to pour.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The סגן holds the cloths at the corner of the מזבח, and two כהנים with trumpets blow תקיעה, תרועה, תקיעה.

steps.title: The pouring and the start of the לוים's song
steps.stepSummary: The trumpet כהנים stand on both sides of בן ארזא. When the כהן גדול bends to pour, the סגן waves the cloths, בן ארזא strikes the cymbal, and the לוים start singing.
steps.simpleTranslation: They came and stood next to בן ארזא, one on his right and one on his left. The כהן גדול bent down to pour the wine. The סגן waved the cloths, בן ארזא struck the cymbal, and the לוים sang the song.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה describes the exact moment of pouring the wine and how it sets off the music.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The waving of the cloths is the signal that starts everything. בן ארזא's cymbal tells the לוים to begin, so the song lines up exactly with the pouring of the wine.

keyTerms.meaning: The title of the person in charge of striking the cymbal
Cymbal
To pour the wine offering
Waved

phrases.english: They came and stood next to ben Arza,
phrases.notes: "They" are the two כהנים with the trumpets from the step before.

phrases.english: one on his right and one on his left.
He bent down to pour the wine,
phrases.notes: "He" here is the כהן גדול.

phrases.english: and the deputy waved the cloths,
and ben Arza struck the cymbal,
and the Levites spoke out in song.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the people set up in step 12 (the סגן with cloths, the trumpet כהנים) to describe the moment the singing begins.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: When the כהן גדול pours the wine, the סגן waves the cloths, בן ארזא strikes the cymbal, and the לוים sing.

steps.title: A trumpet blast and bowing at every section of the song
steps.stepSummary: Every time the לוים finish a section of the song, the כהנים blow a תקיעה and the people bow down.
steps.simpleTranslation: When they reached a section break, they blew a תקיעה and the people bowed down. For every section there was a תקיעה, and for every תקיעה there was a bowing.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה explains what happens during the song: the song is split into sections, and each break gets a trumpet blast and a bow from the people.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה first describes it as a one-time event, then repeats it as a fixed rule: every section gets a blast, and every blast gets a bowing. This makes clear it happens again and again through the whole song.

keyTerms.meaning: A section of the song (here, a section of the פרק תהלים)
Bowing down fully to the ground

phrases.english: When they reached a section, they blew a long blast,
phrases.notes: פרק here doesn't mean a chapter; it means a break between sections of the song the לוים are singing.

phrases.english: and the people bowed down.
For every section, a long blast,
and for every long blast, a bowing.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues from the start of the song in step 13 and describes what happens while it is sung.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: At each section of the song there is a תקיעה, and at each תקיעה the people bow.

steps.title: This is the order of the תמיד, with a prayer for the בית המקדש
steps.stepSummary: The משנה closes its long description: this is the order of the daily תמיד service, and it prays that the בית המקדש be rebuilt soon.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is the order of the תמיד for the service of the House of our God. May it be His will that it be rebuilt quickly in our days, amen.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה wraps up the whole step-by-step description of the תמיד that the מסכת has been laying out, and ends with a prayer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This line is not a new law; it closes the full order of the service. The prayer reminds us that we describe this service because we hope to do it again when the בית המקדש is rebuilt.

keyTerms.meaning: The order of the daily offering service
May it be (God's) will, the opening of a prayer

steps.whatToRemember: The whole order of the תמיד ends with the pouring of the wine, the song of the לוים, trumpet blasts, and the people bowing, and the משנה closes with a prayer for the rebuilding of the בית המקדש.

phrases.english: This is the order of the daily offering
for the service of the House of our God,
may it be His will that it be rebuilt
quickly in our days, amen.

steps.triggerLanguage: זֶהוּ סֵדֶר הַתָּמִיד לַעֲבוֹדַת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the description of the service that ended in step 14.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The full order of the תמיד has now been laid out, and the משנה ends with a prayer for the בית המקדש to be rebuilt.

steps.title: The song of the לוים for each weekday
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה lists which chapter of תהלים the לוים sang in the בית המקדש on each day from Sunday through Friday.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is the song the לוים would say in the בית המקדש. On the first day they said "The earth and everything in it is ה׳'s." On the second they said "ה׳ is great and very praised in the city of our God." On the third they said "God stands in the divine assembly." On the fourth they said "God of vengeance, ה׳." On the fifth they said "Sing joyfully to God our strength." On the sixth they said "ה׳ reigns, He is dressed in majesty."
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It tells us which song the לוים sang each day, which connects to the song mentioned in step 13.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 13 said the לוים sang, but didn't say what. Now the משנה fills that in: each day of the week had its own chapter of תהלים, and it quotes the opening words of each one.

keyTerms.meaning: Song, here the daily song the לוים sang
The Levites, who sang in the בית המקדש
On the first day of the week (Sunday)

steps.whyThisMatters: These are the same chapters we say today as the שיר של יום at the end of שחרית.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each weekday had a set chapter of תהלים: Sunday 24, Monday 48, Tuesday 82, Wednesday 94, Thursday 81, Friday 93.

steps.title: The שבת song is about the future world
steps.stepSummary: On שבת the לוים sang "מזמור שיר ליום השבת," and the משנה explains that this is a song for the future day that will be completely שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: On שבת they would say "A psalm, a song for the day of שבת." This means a psalm, a song for the time to come, for the day that will be all שבת and rest for eternal life.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה finishes the list with שבת, and then explains the meaning of the words of that chapter.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For the other days the משנה just quoted the opening words. For שבת it adds an explanation: "the day of שבת" isn't only our weekly שבת, but the future world, which will be one long שבת of rest.

keyTerms.meaning: "A psalm, a song for the day of שבת" (תהלים 92)
For the time to come, the future world

Eternal life

steps.whatToRemember: Each day had its own song, and the שבת song looks forward to the future world, the day that will be completely שבת and rest.

steps.title: הדרן — Closing פרק בזמן שכהן גדול and מסכת תמיד
steps.stepSummary: The closing line: we will return to the פרק בזמן שכהן גדול, and מסכת תמיד is finished.
steps.simpleTranslation: We will return to you, פרק בזמן שכהן גדול, and מסכת תמיד is finished.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the traditional closing line said at the end of a פרק, and here it also marks the end of the whole מסכת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: No new law is taught here. The הדרן names the פרק by its opening words and says that the learning of מסכת תמיד is complete.

keyTerms.meaning: We will return to you, a closing formula at the end of a פרק
And it is finished
The tractate about the daily offering
